title: Binomial reciprocal expectation formula
statement: For every natural number $m$, the expectation of $1/(2J+1)$ when $J$ has the binomial distribution with $m$ trials and success probability $1/2$ equals $\displaystyle\sum_{j=0}^{m}\binom{m}{j}2^{-m}\frac{1}{2j+1}$.
